tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /me pho 'brug lo dpal zhwa lu'i ma he mchod pa gnang dus kyi sgo yig bka' shog/ shrī man gu ru badz+ra bhai ra wa ye na maḥ rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po nyid nas bzung / bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa yab sras kyis gtso mdzad bdag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rje btsun gnyis spangs zhabs kyi bar du byon pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka'/ khro bo'i dbang po dpal gshin rje gshed kyi lung / dpal zhwa lu gser khang gi gdan sa bcu gsum pa shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dpal dus dgra nag po ma he'i zhal gyi brtul zhugs grub pa'i yi ge srid pa gsum na gnas shing rgyu ba'i 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams la zlo ba/ zla ba 'di'i nyer gsum gyi nyin/ lho phyogs rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og 'jigs rung gshin rje'i grong khyer chen po nas/ dpal gshin rje gshed kyi bka' bstod chen po 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje yab yum/ 'khor las kyi ma gshin pho mo/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ mchod pa dang gtor ma dang bstod pas mnyes par byas/ dmar chen gyi liṅga dang / rdo rje bdud rtsi'i mna' chu blud/ dam tshig gi rdo rje 'bar bas dam la bzhag cing bka' bsgos te/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang / skye dgu sems can yongs kyi bde skyid 'phel bar bya ba'i ched dang khyad par chos grwa 'di nyid kyis gtso byas dge 'dun gyi sde dang / rnal 'byor pa 'khor bcas bde zhing / dam pa'i chos spyod pa'i 'phrin las 'chol ba dang / de dag la gnod cing bar du gcod pa'i mi ma yin pa'i gdug pa can rnams drag po mngon spyod kyi las kyis tshar gcod pa'i cho ga bsgrubs pas/ khyed mi ma yin pa rnams rang rang gis khas blangs dang dam tshig rjes su dran pas mchod gtor gyi tshim par gyis la mthu dang nus pa stobs dang rdzu 'phrul gang yod kyis bar chad bsrung ba'i phrin las sgrubs/

'dir 'dus shing tshogs pa'i mi rnams kyang bsam sbyor dge zhing zhi ba'i sgo nas ngo mtshar gyi ltad mos yid tshims pa dang / ma rungs pa'i las byas na 'di lta bu'i 'phrin las kyi sgo nas tshar gcod 'ong snyam pa'i skrag shes pa gyis/ gal srid kha drag shed khyer/ mi bsha'/ kha mchu gsar rnying / 'brel bu lon/ ltes gtang 'dzin/ spyod ngan gshis ngan gyi sgo nas rgyab 'dre 'thab rtsod zing rkyen byas pa byung na/ chos sde chen po'i spyi pa nas lugs gnyis dang mthun rtsad gcod phyi lam khegs pa gtong ba dang / 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed kyi rnal 'byor rab tu khros pas bka' bsgos te/ lte bo su yin pa de 'chi bdag gshin rje nag po'i zas skal du 'phral du ster bas nges par gyis la/ so so tha dad nas dran 'dzin dang bag yod la gnas pas dge zhing zhi ba gal che/ me pho 'brug lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu la dpal zhwa lu gser khang gi bla brang chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas bris/ sgo yig 'di la 'phral du gnod pa byung na bstan srung chen mo rdo rje rab brtan mas tshar chod/ dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 tshar chen blo gsal rgya mtsho/ me pho 'brug lo dpal zhwa lu'i ma he mchod pa gnang dus kyi sgo yig bka' shog PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
